comparisons.peer_topic: Sources of Credit Risk in Wealth Management
comparisons.peer_summary: The Wealth Management business segment incurs credit risk primarily through lending to individuals and entities, including margin loans, securities-based lending, single-family residential mortgage loans, and employee loans.
comparisons.comparison: Both C and MS identify margin loans and mortgage loans as key components of their Wealth Management credit risk profiles. C specifies that its classifiably managed portfolio primarily consists of mortgage loans, margin loans, and personal/small business loans. MS details that its Wealth Management credit risk is primarily incurred through lending activities including margin loans and single-family residential mortgage loans, highlighting a similar composition of secured and securities-based lending within their wealth divisions.
